title: The Price of a Favour
fact_notes: 人物・出来事・制度・観測は架空の思考実験。実在の調査・統計・実証結果や観測施設の運用規則ではない。制作台帳は来歴確認用。

sentences.en: Imagine a fictional university in which students regularly exchange assistance with practical activities, ranging from helping someone move furniture to explaining a difficult part of an assignment.
sentences.ja: 家具移動の手伝いから課題の難所の説明まで実務的活動で学生が定期的に助け合う架空の大学を想像しよう。

sentences.en: A student organization proposes introducing a digital system that records the approximate amount of time each participant contributes, allowing students to use accumulated credits when they subsequently request assistance from someone else.
sentences.ja: 学生団体は各参加者の貢献時間の概算を記録し、後で他者に支援を求めるとき蓄積したポイントを使えるデジタル仕組みを提案する。

sentences.en: Supporters believe that this arrangement could make cooperation easier among people who do not already know one another and who might otherwise hesitate to ask for help.
sentences.ja: 支持者は通常なら助けを求めるのをためらう初対面の人々の間で協力しやすくなると考える。

sentences.en: Other students question whether translating every contribution into a numerical credit might change the meaning of activities that they previously regarded as expressions of generosity or friendship.
sentences.ja: 別の学生は全貢献を数値ポイントに変換すると以前寛大さや友情の表現と考えていた行為の意味が変わるか疑問を持つ。

sentences.en: The organization begins by distinguishing the intended purpose of the system from the broader social relationships that exist among its potential participants.
sentences.ja: 団体は仕組みの意図した目的と参加候補者間のより広い社会関係を区別することから始める。

sentences.en: Its supporters point out that a clearly defined exchange can be useful when people wish to obtain assistance without feeling that they have accepted an indefinite personal obligation.
sentences.ja: 期限のない個人的義務を受け入れたと感じず援助を得たい人には明確な交換が有用と指摘する。

sentences.en: The critics respond that some kinds of assistance may be difficult to evaluate fairly using time alone, particularly when an apparently brief contribution depends on considerable previous experience or preparation.
sentences.ja: 批判者は特に短い貢献がかなりの過去経験や準備に依存する場合時間だけで公平に評価しにくい援助もあると答える。

sentences.en: They also worry that students might begin to expect recognition for ordinary considerate behavior that nobody had previously regarded as something requiring a measurable reward.
sentences.ja: 以前誰も測定可能な報酬を必要と考えなかった普通の思いやりのある行動にも認知を期待し始めるかもしれないと懸念する。

sentences.en: Rather than declaring that measurable exchange and voluntary generosity are inherently incompatible, the organization considers limiting the purpose for which its proposed system can be used.
sentences.ja: 測定可能な交換と自発的親切が本質的に両立しないと宣言せず提案仕組みを利用できる目的を限定することを考える。

sentences.en: A clearly described request would identify the expected task and approximate commitment in advance so that participants could decide whether to accept it under the stated conditions.
sentences.ja: 明確に記述された依頼は予想作業とおおよその拘束時間を事前に特定し参加者が明示条件で受けるか決められるようにする。

sentences.en: The system would not automatically record every instance of assistance observed among students or imply that informal acts of kindness should be converted into transactions.
sentences.ja: 学生間で観察された全援助を自動記録せず非公式の親切を取引に変えるべきと示唆しない。

sentences.en: The group also considers how the arrangement might accommodate people whose circumstances limit the amount of time they can contribute, without promising that a single mechanism can resolve every inequality in access to assistance.
sentences.ja: 貢献できる時間を制限する事情を持つ人をどう受け入れられるかも、一つの仕組みで援助アクセスの全不平等を解決すると約束せず検討する。

sentences.en: During a hypothetical evaluation of the proposal, the students discuss several situations in which a request could be interpreted differently by the people involved.
sentences.ja: 仮想評価で関係者により依頼の解釈が異なり得る複数状況を議論する。

sentences.en: One person might appreciate the clarity of an explicit exchange, whereas another might prefer to offer the same assistance without receiving anything in return.
sentences.ja: 明示的交換の明確さを評価する人もいれば見返りなしに同じ援助を提供したい人もいる。

sentences.en: The organization recognizes that neither preference necessarily demonstrates greater moral commitment, since the meaning of an action can depend on the expectations under which it is offered and received.
sentences.ja: 行為の意味は提供・受領時の期待に依存するのでどちらの好みも必ずしも道徳的関与の強さを示さないと認識する。

sentences.en: It proposes making participation voluntary and examining whether the arrangement helps participants achieve its stated purpose without creating unreasonable social pressure to quantify unrelated aspects of their relationships.
sentences.ja: 任意参加にし人間関係の無関係な側面を数値化する過度の社会的圧力を生まず明示目的を達成できるか調べる案を出す。

sentences.en: The fictional example illustrates how a tool designed to facilitate cooperation can also introduce a particular interpretation of the activities it helps organize.
sentences.ja: 架空例は協力を促す道具が組織化する活動の特定解釈も導入し得ることを示す。

sentences.en: A numerical record can provide useful information about an agreed exchange without necessarily representing the complete value of the contribution involved.
sentences.ja: 数値記録は合意された交換の有益な情報を提供しても貢献の完全な価値を必ずしも表さない。

sentences.en: Ethical design therefore involves examining not only what a system makes easier to do but also which expectations become more prominent when the system is introduced into an existing community.
sentences.ja: 倫理的設計は仕組みが何を容易にするかだけでなく既存共同体への導入でどんな期待が目立つようになるかの検討も伴う。

sentences.en: The challenge is to preserve the practical benefits of explicit arrangements without assuming that every valuable human interaction must be understood according to the same logic of measurement and exchange.
sentences.ja: 課題は全ての価値ある人間交流を同じ測定と交換の論理で理解すべきと想定せず明示取り決めの実際的利益を守ることだ。

vocabulary.definition: thought of in a certain way

questions.prompt: What does the proposed system record?
options: The monetary price of all furniture.

questions.prompt: Why might the system help strangers cooperate?
options: Credits could clarify expectations in exchanges.

questions.prompt: Why might an explicit exchange be useful?
options: It proves every act has equal value.
It can avoid a sense of indefinite personal obligation.
It requires people to become close friends.
questions.explanation_ja: 無期限の義務感を避ける。

questions.prompt: What limitation of time-based measurement is raised?
options: Brief help may depend on extensive prior expertise.

questions.prompt: What would a clearly described request identify?
options: Every act of kindness by each student.
A fixed moral score for each participant.
The task and approximate commitment beforehand.
To avoid turning all informal kindness into transactions.
To guarantee that no request will be refused.
questions.explanation_ja: 親切の取引化を避ける。

questions.prompt: Why avoid ranking the two preferences morally?
options: The meaning of help depends on the expectations involved.
Only numerical rewards establish moral value.

questions.prompt: What condition does the organization propose?
options: Eliminating all nonparticipants from the university.
Every form of assistance should be quantified.
Measurable exchange and generosity can never coexist.
Systems that organize cooperation should preserve practical benefits without imposing one interpretation on all human relationships.
All numerical records are ethically unacceptable.
questions.explanation_ja: 交換の利点と人間関係の多様な価値。

grammar.focus: allowing students to use accumulated credits
grammar.explanation_ja: 分詞構文で結果・機能を補足。

paraphrases.rewrite: The organization limits the tool's purpose instead of declaring exchange and generosity incompatible.
